freezePolicy.purpose: Independent frozen semantic quality corpus for comparing the same Jev compiler with and without GLiNER candidate extraction.
freezePolicy.goldSource: Human interpretation of only the user text, the frozen reference time, and for follow-ups the preceding gold meaning. The experiment must feed each arm its own actual returned state, never this gold prior.

supportedSemanticSchema.primaryTopics: Source-grounded required topic predicates; an explicitly alternative topic remains one pipe-delimited predicate rather than separate AND entries.

unknownAndUnsupportedPolicy.unknownEvidence: A supported predicate whose event evidence may be unknown is still part of intent and is not an unsupported request.
unknownAndUnsupportedPolicy.mandatoryUnsupported: Return unsupported and preserve the complete actual previous state atomically.
unknownAndUnsupportedPolicy.optionalUnsupported: May remain executable only when explicitly optional; record the exact raw phrase in unappliedPreferences and do not turn it into a hard predicate or claim it can be verified.
unknownAndUnsupportedPolicy.ambiguity: Return clarify and preserve the complete actual previous state; do not invent a budget basis, location, or category logic.

expectedFormat.state: Every turn carries a full canonical IntentState v1. Executable follow-ups are expanded from the preceding GOLD state for scoring only.
expectedFormat.armFeeding: The harness must feed each arm its own actual prior state. It must never feed expected.state.
expectedFormat.notApplied: Explicit optional requests outside IntentState v1 are exact-span annotations for manual review and are not committed hard constraints.
expectedFormat.freeTextReview: Free-text primaryTopics, interests, and notApplied preferences require exact-span/manual semantic review; they are not auto-scored by loose string similarity.
expectedFormat.strictness: Scoring compares the complete canonical state and rejects unexpected extra fields or predicates.

freezePolicy.disputedGoldPolicy: A turn marked goldDisputed is frozen for diagnostic reporting but excluded from the automatic accuracy gate until independent human adjudication.

preCallCorrections.reason: Independent human-readable semantic/gold review before any Jev experiment call. Original input texts are unchanged, and original corpus/gold retained.

changes.reason: Optional category wording has multiple defensible readings. Keep original expectation but exclude strict accuracy gate; report budget/date/category components independently.
Explicit optional known category is representable as a preference; it is not an unsupported/unapplied capability.
Taksim is a neighborhood, not a supported exact district; a hard Taksim request cannot be satisfied by broadening to Beyoglu.
